title: Damped Harmonic Oscillator
description: The linear oscillator family with a restoring force and nonnegative velocity-proportional damping, including the zero-damping limit. It contains underdamped, critically damped, and overdamped regimes; the latter two do not exhibit sustained back-and-forth motion.

relations.note: The model family includes zero damping, which recovers the undamped harmonic oscillator.
Combine a linear restoring force with a force proportional and opposite to velocity.
